import zipfile, shutil, os, re

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_new.xlsx'

z = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
entries = {n: z.read(n) for n in z.namelist()}
z.close()

sheet = entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'].decode('utf-8')
styles = entries['xl/styles.xml'].decode('utf-8')

# 1. Update dimension to include column H
assert 'ref="A1:G10"' in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace('ref="A1:G10"', 'ref="A1:H10"')

# 2. Add column width for H
assert '<cols>' in sheet and '</cols>' in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace('</cols>', '<col width="14" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>', 1)

# 3. Header H1 (same style as other headers, s=1)
old_h1 = '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c>'
new_h1 = old_h1 + '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin</t></is></c>'
assert old_h1 in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace(old_h1, new_h1, 1)

# 4. Data rows 2-9: margin = Profit / Revenue
for n in range(2, 10):
    old = f'<c r="G{n}"><f>E{n}-C{n}*F{n}</f><v></v></c></row>'
    new = old.replace('</row>', f'<c r="H{n}" s="3"><f>G{n}/E{n}</f><v></v></c></row>')
    assert old in sheet, f'missing row {n}'
    sheet = sheet.replace(old, new, 1)

# 5. TOTAL row 10: overall margin = total profit / total revenue
old10 = '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c></row>'
new10 = old10.replace('</row>', '<c r="H10" s="3"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c></row>')
assert old10 in sheet
sheet = sheet.replace(old10, new10, 1)

# 6. Styles: add a 0.0% percentage number format (numFmtId=165) and cell style s=3
assert '<numFmts count="0"/>' in styles
styles = styles.replace('<numFmts count="0"/>',
                        '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="165" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>', 1)
assert '<cellXfs count="3">' in styles
styles = styles.replace('<cellXfs count="3">', '<cellXfs count="4">', 1)
assert '</cellXfs>' in styles
styles = styles.replace('</cellXfs>',
    '<xf numFmtId="165" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0" applyNumberFormat="1"/></cellXfs>', 1)

entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = sheet.encode('utf-8')
entries['xl/styles.xml'] = styles.encode('utf-8')

with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for name, data in entries.items():
        zout.writestr(name, data)

os.replace(TMP, SRC)
print('done')

import zipfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, re

z = zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx')
print("zip test (bad file):", z.testzip())
names = z.namelist()
print("entries:", len(names))

# All XML parts must parse
for n in names:
    if n.endswith('.xml') or n.endswith('.rels'):
        ET.fromstring(z.read(n))
print("all XML parts well-formed: OK")

sheet = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
styles = z.read('xl/styles.xml').decode('utf-8')

# Verify dimension, col, header, formulas
assert 'ref="A1:H10"' in sheet, 'dimension'
assert 'min="8" max="8"' in sheet, 'col H width'
assert '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin</t></is></c>' in sheet, 'H1 header'
for n in range(2, 10):
    assert f'<c r="H{n}" s="3"><f>G{n}/E{n}</f><v></v></c>' in sheet, f'H{n}'
assert '<c r="H10" s="3"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c>' in sheet, 'H10'
assert 'numFmtId="165" formatCode="0.0%"' in styles, 'numFmt'
assert 'numFmtId="165" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0' in styles, 'xf'
print("H column cells + styles present: OK")

# Parse values for sanity check (formula correctness)
data = {}
for n in range(2, 10):
    units = int(re.search(f'<c r="C{n}" t="n"><v>(\\d+)</v></c>', sheet).group(1))
    price = int(re.search(f'<c r="D{n}" t="n"><v>(\\d+)</v></c>', sheet).group(1))
    cost = int(re.search(f'<c r="F{n}" t="n"><v>(\\d+)</v></c>', sheet).group(1))
    rev = units * price
    profit = rev - units * cost
    data[n] = (rev, profit, profit / rev)

for n, (rev, profit, margin) in data.items():
    print(f"row {n}: Revenue={rev}, Profit={profit}, Margin={margin:.3%}")

tot_rev = sum(v[0] for v in data.values())
tot_profit = sum(v[1] for v in data.values())
print(f"TOTAL: Revenue={tot_rev}, Profit={tot_profit}, Overall Margin={tot_profit/tot_rev:.3%}")
assert all(rev > 0 for rev, _, _ in data.values()), 'revenue must be > 0 (no #DIV/0!)'
print("all denominators positive: no #DIV/0! risk")
